widgets.label: {{w:stdbuf -oL pw-dump -m 2>/dev/null | jq -nr --unbuffered 'foreach inputs as $c ({d:null,s:{},g:null,e:null}; (reduce ($c[]? | select(.info? != null or .metadata? != null)) as $o (.; if ($o.info?.props?["media.class"] == "Audio/Sink") and ($o.info?.params?.Props?[0]? != null) then .s[$o.info.props["node.name"]] = ($o.info.params.Props[0].mute == true) elif ($o.metadata? != null) then .d = (($o.metadata[]? | select(.key == "default.audio.sink") | .value.name) // .d) else . end)) | if .d and (.s[.d] != null) and (.s[.d] != .g) then .e = (if .s[.d] then "󰝟" else "󰕾" end) | .g = .s[.d] else .e = null end; .e // empty)'}}

widgets.value: w:stdbuf -oL pw-dump -m 2>/dev/null | jq -nr --unbuffered 'foreach inputs as $c ({d:null,s:{},g:null,e:null}; (reduce ($c[]? | select(.info? != null or .metadata? != null)) as $o (.; if ($o.info?.props?["media.class"] == "Audio/Sink") and ($o.info?.params?.Props?[0]?.channelVolumes != null) then .s[$o.info.props["node.name"]] = (($o.info.params.Props[0].channelVolumes[0] | pow(.; 1/3)) * 100 | round) elif ($o.metadata? != null) then .d = (($o.metadata[]? | select(.key == "default.audio.sink") | .value.name) // .d) else . end)) | if .d and (.s[.d] != null) and (.s[.d] != .g) then .e = .s[.d] | .g = .s[.d] else .e = null end; .e // empty)'

w:l=$(awk 'NR==FNR{m=$1;next}{printf "%d", $1/m*100}' /sys/class/backlight/*/max_brightness /sys/class/backlight/*/brightness); printf "$l\n"; stdbuf -oL udevadm monitor --kernel --subsystem-match=backlight 2>/dev/null | while read -r _; do v=$(awk 'NR==FNR{m=$1;next}{printf "%d", $1/m*100}' /sys/class/backlight/*/max_brightness /sys/class/backlight/*/brightness); [ "$v" != "$l" ] && { l=$v; printf "$v\n"; }; done
